title: Assistant Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remoto

Na Blue Dot BPO, conectamos talentos LATAM a equipes executivas de alta performance em empresas norte-americanas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Recruiter Assistant com excelente comunicação em inglês, organização e proatividade para atuar em operações de recrutamento de alto volume. A posição é totalmente remota, voltada ao mercado dos EUA, com exposição diária a times globais e trilha clara de crescimento para quem deseja construir carreira em recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$3.500 reais.
  • 100% remoto, atuando diretamente com equipes de recrutamento dos Estados Unidos.
  • Turno de segunda a sexta, das 13h às 22h BRT .
  • Oportunidade de crescimento acelerado (carreira em recrutamento executivo, liderança ou gestão).
  • Networking internacional + ambiente multicultural.
  • Treinamento remunerado e acompanhamento estruturado.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de recrutamento do cliente (EUA) na busca e pré-qualificação de candidatos.
  • Realizar triagens iniciais via chamadas telefônicas, e-mail e mensagens.
  • Manter bases de dados atualizadas (job boards e ATS).
  • Redigir e atualizar job descriptions e perfis de vaga.
  • Mapear talentos em job boards e bancos de currículos.
  • Gerenciar agendas e apoiar o fluxo de comunicação entre candidatos e recrutadores.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à operação e organização do time de recrutamento.


O que buscamos

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação escrita e falada obrigatória.
  • Organização, foco e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Perfil detalhista, proativo e orientado a entregas.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento ou talent acquisition.
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics ou outros ATS.
  • Vivência com operações de alto volume e prazos desafiadores.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Dois monitores | Processador i5/i7 (ou equivalente) | 12GB+ RAM .
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset com microfone e ambiente silencioso.


Construa sua carreira em recrutamento!


Se você quer trabalhar diretamente com equipes dos EUA, adquirir experiência relevante e evoluir rapidamente, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Solution Architect (Modern Work)
description:
We are currently searching for a Portuguese speaking Solution Architect/Developer to work with our biggest customer remotely in Brazil.


In this role you will leverage your technical expertise in Microsoft Teams and Viva to deliver proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in Brazil.


The following proficiencies are required:


  • Fluent/native Portuguese written & oral communication
  • Design and development experience in major Viva components
  • Experience in integrating Viva with relevant technologies
  • Deep knowledge and experience in Teams Telephony and app development
  • Experience in customer and stakeholder management


If you are a seasoned professional, possessing the above proficiencies, please apply!


We look forward to receiving your applications.


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager

Duration: Fulltime with CriticalRiver

Location: Brazil/Costa Rica

Need to support PST timings

Job Profile:

  • Manage delivery for our key customers across all the technological tracks
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Ensure regular updates to customer stake holders sent through WSRs
  • Conduct MBRs and QBRs
  • Achieve high customer delight


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget by working with technology teams.
  • Work closely with customer stake holders and ensure the project scope is well understood and documented as per the defined standards
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Work with PMO and ensure quality control procedures to ensure high standards in the delivery.
  • Act as a delivery point of contact for Customer, Understanding the Customer, managing expectations and ensuring highest customer satisfaction.
  • Service/Project Review meetings with Customer and Management
  • Adopt customer specific processes and methodologies.
  • Proactively Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks effectively.
  • Ensure that the project teams meet SLAs and avoid service credits / penalties.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Utilize effective conflict resolution and negotiation tactics to maintain high-level performance within service teams.
  • Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs as performance metrics for team members.

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.
company: 绿新(福建)食品有限公司

title: Software Engineer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Software Engineer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs using Apigee (preferred), KrakenD, or AWS API Gateway.
  • Implement scalable and secure API architectures using REST, gRPC, and GraphQL.
  • Develop backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and frontend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript with React or Angular.
  • Work with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP for deployment, scaling, and monitoring.
  • Utilize CI/CD pipelines (ADO Pipelines), GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes to manage code, build processes, and deployments.
  • Write robust unit, integration, and automated tests using tools such as Cucumber and Mockito.
  • Contribute to cross-organization API standards, documentation, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Agile/Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall professional experience.
  • Java (Spring Boot):
  • API Development:
  • API Management (Apigee/KrakenD/AWS Gateway): 3 years
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP):
  • JavaScript/TypeScript:
  • React/Angular:
  • Strong understanding of API protocols and architectural patterns (REST, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Proficiency with CI/CD, GitHub, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience writing automated tests (Cucumber, Mockito).
  • Ability to write clear documentation and contribute to API governance efforts.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Title- Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)

Type of Hire- Full Time


Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)


Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Analista de rede
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. title: Scrum Master
description:
Contract Duration: 6 to 12 months

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor / Contract

Work Model: Nearshore – Remote

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)


About the Opportunity

We are a staffing and recruitment consultancy supporting one of our clients with a long-term project. We are seeking a Scrum Master to join a Product & Engineering environment, supporting one to two Scrum teams and contributing to the continuous improvement of Agile practices.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for a professional who is comfortable working with distributed teams and collaborating closely with Agile leadership.


Experience Level

Mid-level (2–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master)


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, ensuring alignment with Agile principles
  • Support and guide one Scrum team, with potential responsibility for a second team
  • Partner with an enterprise Agile Coach to improve team performance and delivery
  • Assist with the implementation and adoption of SAFe practices
  • Identify, escalate, and help remove impediments impacting team progress
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation and feedback
  • Work closely with mid-level managers and cross-functional team members across multiple regions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience as a dedicated Scrum Master
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Scrum of Scrums)
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework); certifications are a strong plus
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and navigate team conflicts
  • Experience working with distributed, global teams


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Adaptability, flexibility, and a proactive attitude
  • Ability to challenge ideas constructively and negotiate pushback when needed
  • Independent thinker with a continuous improvement mindset


Education & Certifications

  • SAFe certification is highly desired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (optional)


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and evolve within Agile frameworks

title: Analista Desenvolvedor de Sistemas (Equipe de Novos Produtos)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista Desenvolvedor de Sistemas FullStack Pleno para integrar nosso time de tecnologia.

Procuramos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por desenvolvimento, com experiência sólida em .Net e Angular, capaz de atuar em todas as camadas da aplicação, desde o back-end até a interface com o usuário.


Principais atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web fullstack utilizando .Net, Angular e Angular Material;
  • Modelar e manipular dados utilizando Entity Framework;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código e boas práticas de versionamento com Git;
  • Colaborar em times ágeis, participando de dailys, plannings e code reviews;
  • Contribuir na análise técnica, evolução de sistemas e implementação de novas funcionalidades.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Experiência em .Net (C#) e Angular;
  • Conhecimento em Angular Material para construção de interfaces modernas e responsivas;
  • Experiência com Entity Framework;
  • Versionamento de código com Git;
  • Vivência em times ágeis (Scrum)


Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Jira, Confluence e SourceTree
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência em todo o ciclo de vida da aplicação (análise, desenvolvimento, testes e suporte)
  • Inglês avançado

title: Medical Science Liaison - Dermatology - Brazil
description:
Canopy Life Sciences is a well-respected vendor & partner in the life sciences industry, assisting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients in various functional areas of expertise. Our culture is one of empowerment. Everyone has a voice and plays a role in the success of the business and a role in developing our values & behaviors. We recruit, train, and develop people to ensure the very best for our client partners.



Medical Science Liaison – Dermatology - Brazil


This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:


Clinical Trial Support :


  • Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.
  • Engage with clinical trial sites and investigators to ensure smooth trial operations and alignment with study objectives.
  • Provide education and training to clinical sites on study protocols and therapeutic areas.


Insight Generation and Framework Creation :


  • Gather and synthesize insights from healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and other stakeholders to identify referral patterns, challenges, and opportunities for trial enrollment.
  • Develop frameworks to streamline patient identification and referral pathways.


Stakeholder Engagement :


  • Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.
  • Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.


Cross-Border Collaboration :


  • Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.
  • Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.


Travel Requirements :


  • Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.


Independent Work :


  • Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.
  • Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.
  • Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.
  • Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.
  • Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.
  • Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.
  • Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.




Compensation - DOE

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).
  • Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).
  • Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Security:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).

DevOps and Monitoring:

  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.

Data and Analytics:

  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.

Cloud Architecture:

  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
Olá Rede,


Somos uma empresa consolidada na área de Tecnologia e estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista DevOps, no modelo 100% remoto.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior em Análise de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em funções de DevOps, SRE, Engenharia de Plataforma ou SysOps.
  • Conhecimento profundo e prático com orquestração de container Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift, Azure Red Hat Openshift, Red Hat Openshift Service on AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada em implantação, atualização e sustentação de Openshift.
  • Experiência comprovada com Ansible e Terraform para automação e gerenciamento de configuração.
  • Vivência na implementação e gestão de RH-SSO, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, WSO2.
  • Conhecimento na implantação e gestão do 3scale, Kong, Azure API management, Amazon API Gateway.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de nuvem híbrida e provedores de nuvem pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Habilidades em scripting (Shell, Python ou Go) e Git para controle de versão.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps (CAMS - Cultura, Automação, Medição e Compartilhamento).
  • Experiência com serviços de missão crítica com alta disponibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido com infraestrutura de TI, sistemas operacionais e redes.
  • Experiência com esteiras CI/CD utilizando ferramentas Jenkins, Gitlab, Github, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps e AWS CodeComit.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Red Hat (ex: Red Hat Certified Engineer - RHCE, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration).
  • Certificações AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator.
  • Certificações Azure AZ-104 Azure Adminsitrator Associate, AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer Expert.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK ou Dynatrace.


Importante:

  • Regime CLT | Jornada integral.
  • Nível de experiência: Senior.
  • Oportunidade 100% Home Office.


Salário e Benefícios:

  • Faixa Salarial: entre R$ 13.000,00 e 14.000,00.
  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Odontológica, Vale Refeição, PLR, Auxilio Home Office, Seguro de Vida, Vale Transporte, Auxílio Creche, Wellhub, Previdência Privada, Cursos Alura e Day Off.

Descrição da vaga


A FCamara apoiando empresas disruptivas por meio de soluções digitais completas e escaláveis alinhadas às principais tendências e necessidades do mercado. Temos uma cultura poderosa, conectados de ponta a ponta, colaborativos, ágeis e flexíveis para encarar o novo, transparentes em nossas ações e unidos por um grande propósito: Revolucionar negócios e impactar pessoas, resolvendo desafios complexos através da nossa cultura e tecnologia. Além disso, somos certificados pela GPTW pelo segundo ano consecutivo, sendo uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil.


Próximos dos clientes, apaixonados por tecnologia e pessoas (sim, aqui pensamos na sua evolução e carreira, vamos te desenvolver e cuidar da sua trilha de capacitação). Acreditamos na diversidade, equidade e inclusão de profissionais independente da sua deficiência, raça/ etnia, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, origem e constituição de família.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

· Atuar no desenvolvimento de software, escrevendo códigos para desenvolver aplicativos, programas e sistemas de software, seguindo as especificações e requisitos do projeto;

· Efetuar testes nos softwares desenvolvidos, identificando e corrigindo problemas, bugs e falhas no código, garantindo a qualidade da entrega, cumprimento de prazos e satisfação do cliente.

· Documentar códigos desenvolvidos, visando facilitar a manutenção e atualização posterior dos produtos;

· Desenvolver soluções de software de alta qualidade, garantindo que o código seja eficiente, escalável e manutenível;

· Acompanhar e monitorar os sistemas em produção para identificar problemas e implementar soluções.


Requisitos e qualificações

- Experiência prévia comprovada como dev fullstack (backend e frontend);

- Backend: java, spring boot, APIs Rest, dataflow

- Frontend: angularjs, node, javascript

- Testes: jmeter

- Bancos de dados: relacional e não relacional, SQL, NoSQL

- Práticas DevOps e desenvolvimento: GCP (GKE), Jenkins, Veracode, Sonar, Bitbucket, Git, spinnaker

- Agilidade: Scrum, Jira


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia em projetos de crédito ou financeiro.

- Conhecimento em sistemas de concessão, gestão de crédito e limites.

  • - Conhecimento em análise de dados e monitoramento de sistemas 2

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

description:
Sobre a vaga


A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que buscamos?

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor GO Pleno.


Experiência com:

  • Experiência em linguagens de programação GoLang (indispensável )
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Conhecimentos Cloud, AWS
  • Experiencia Kubernetes e Docker
  • Experiencia com Desenvolvimento com testes automatizados
  • Experiencia com Mensageria
  • Experiencia com: TDD, Arquitetura Hexagonal, Clean Architecture, CI/CD, Observabilidade, Testes Unitários, Qualidade de software, Github.


Desejável:

  • Ter trabalhado em fintech ou em alguma empresa que tenha ligação com Cartões de Débito / Crédito.

Oportunidade: Remoto.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

title: Data Analyst
description:
Descrição da Função


Esta é uma função remota em tempo integral para Analista de Dados . O Analista de Dados será responsável por coletar, organizar, analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados para identificar padrões e tendências. A coleta ocorrerá em bancos de dados próprios bem como a busca de dados em bases externas, de forma automatizada e também de forma manual (que pode vir a ser automatizada, fazendo parte da função). Também irá desenvolver e manter painéis de dados (dashboards), criar modelos de dados e auxiliar na melhoria dos processos de tomada de decisão do negócio, alimentar e criar planilhas. Além disso, a função inclui a preparação de relatórios e a apresentação clara de insights para as partes interessadas.

Qualificações

  • Proficiência em Análise de Dados e compreensão abrangente do trabalho com grandes volumes de dados
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de identificar tendências e insights acionáveis
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Estatística para analisar dados e gerar conclusões precisas
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para apresentar insights e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados e criação de visualizações eficazes
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e softwares estatísticos como SQL, Python, R é desejável
  • Conhecimento em Excel avançado é necessário
  • Conhecimento básico de Ingles é necessário.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente remoto em tempo integral
  • Graduação em Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada é altamente desejável

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:


Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. title: PLM Engineer III
description:
PLM Engineer III @ Remote


Job Summary:

In this role, the PLM Engineer III will serve as a technical expert in the areas of infrastructure related to manufacturing information systems. The engineer will identify methods and architect solutions to provide a high level of service to end-users of the application(s). This role will help build out, maintain, and troubleshoot a rapidly expanding application system and its infrastructure. The Engineer will work closely with other engineers, analysts, and leadership to obtain regular feedback on design and execution. Additionally, the Engineer will provide periodic operational support and maintenance of the manufacturing systems.


Essential Duties:

• Responsible for the maintenance, optimization, troubleshooting, upgrades, installation and documentation of infrastructure related to Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems which

includes PLM database management, project management systems, CAD and PDM systems,

• Administration of new and existing technologies, including the design, documentation, install, configuration, maintenance, integration, and testing related systems

• Leads collaboratively with business customers on hardware, middleware, and application requirements.

• Leads with vendors, engineers, analysts, and leadership to ensure the integrity of databases, application software and data

• Performs regular system monitoring, verifying the integrity, health and availability of all systems and key processes, reviewing application and system logs, and ensuring completion of scheduled jobs

• Leads problem-solving efforts regarding system and service matters and if necessary, facilitates support with outside personnel, organizations, and/or vendors

• Monitor tech-industry trends, and brings new ideas and innovative solutions

• Develop new deliverables as needed based on operational requirements and following best practices for documentation and delivery

• Analyzes data to drive decision making and recommendations.

• Configure and deploy devices and peripherals as necessary

• Resolves issues, problems and questions on-site assigned from a ticketing system


Qualifications: Requirements - Required and/or Preferred


Education:

• Basic: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or similar discipline, and/or equivalent related work experience

• Preferred: PLM Certification


Essential Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with ARAS (PLM tool) and SolidWorks (CAD system)

• Minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in a factory or enterprise setting

• Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience with PLM

• Technical expertise with PLM systems such as CAD, PDM, ERP, PMO

• Excellent communication (oral and written) skills, including the ability to explain and present technical information

• Effectively train and advise users on information technology issues

• Prepare written documentation in a clear and concise style

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, flexible environment and take the initiative to learn new tools and concepts quickly

• Creative thinker with attention to detail, strong analytical, multitasking, and interpersonal skills

• Approachable and adaptable

• Ability to work extended-hours or outside of normal business hours including weekends as needed

• Skills in MS Office (Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)

• Must have working-level knowledge of the English language, including reading, writing, and speaking English


Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience in a factory environment desirable

• Technical experience with database management & language (SQL, Oracle)

• Able to work independently and in a team environment, as well as with cross-functional groups

• Resilient, self-motived and able to work well under pressure

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java e Agentes de IA II
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java com experiência em engenharia de software, mentalidade DevOps e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções com agentes de IA, automação inteligente e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs), no projeto BSS, do ICC SOFT.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e aplicações em Java, garantindo alta performance, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Construir, testar e implantar agentes de IA para automação de processos de negócio;
  • Integrar LLMs com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços externos e ferramentas corporativas;
  • Contribuir para pipelines de RAG, mecanismos de memória e recuperação eficiente de contexto;
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos fluxos envolvendo agentes de IA e automações inteligentes;
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, integração e funcionais);
  • Escrever testes específicos para componentes agentic AI;
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de ambientes de desenvolvimento, homologação e produção.
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD para build, teste e deploy contínuo;
  • Utilizar conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes) para implantações;
  • Assegurar observabilidade e monitoramento de workflows agentic AI;
  • Participar de code reviews, sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e atuar como referência para demandas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Revisar e manter documentação detalhada de arquitetura, componentes, integrações e processos de deploy;
  • Registrar decisões técnicas e padrões adotados para uso de IA e automação.



Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou correlatos;


Experiência em:

  • Desenvolvimento Java e POO,
  • Microsserviços e APIs REST,
  • Automação de testes (unitários, integração ou funcionais),
  • Ferramentas GIT,
  • LLMs e frameworks de IA (ex: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel);


Domínio em Java e Python

  • Node.js ou outra linguagem é diferencial;


Conhecimento em bancos de dados (SQL Server, Oracle, Cassandra ou similares);


Noções de vetores, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais;


Compreensão de APIs, microservices e conceitos básicos de cloud;


Boa capacidade de depuração, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica;


Inglês em nível avançado/fluente para contato diário com equipes internacionais.



Seria interessante se você tivesse:


Experiência em:

  • Multi-agent systems ou agents com function-calling,
  • TDD ou BDD,
  • Conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes;


Conhecimento em:

  • Grafos e Graph DBs (ex: Neo4j),
  • Ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions),
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK),
  • Telecom (não obrigatório);


Familiaridade com plataformas de cloud.



Informações adicionais


Horário de trabalho : Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h às 17h.


Local de trabalho: As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de teletrabalho “Home Office”.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js + Terraform)
description:
About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • Professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript.
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Professional experience with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .
  • English proficiency for professional communication.


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.
